```{r}
library(stargazer)

```




```{r}

headers_proxies = c(
  "cold_excess_instrument",
  "heat_excess_instrument",
  "log_diff_pred_unavail",
  "log_diff_renewable",
  "diff_cbf"
)

result_esp <- run_iv_analysis(IV_data_log_esp %>% 
                                rename(cold_excess_instrument =cold_excess_supply,
                                       heat_excess_instrument = heat_excess_supply ),
                              headers_var, headers_proxies, p = 4,
                                dependent = "", k = 2)

result_fr <- run_iv_analysis(IV_data_log_fr, headers_var, headers_proxies, p = 4,
                              dependent = "", k = 2)
```



```{r, results = 'asis'}
models <- list(
  result_esp$m_price_summary,
  result_esp$m_demand_summary,
  result_fr$m_price_summary,
  result_fr$m_demand_summary
)

models_valid <- Filter(function(m) inherits(m, "lm"), models)

reg_table <- stargazer(
  models_valid,
  column.labels = c("ES", "ES", "FR", "FR"),
  dep.var.labels = c("Price", "Demand", "Price", "Demand"),
  type = "html",
  title = "First stage Regression"
)

```
